newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HUVITUSFOND TO BASE NEW BOND RATE ON TALIBOR.
newsitem.headline: HUVITUSFOND TO BASE NEW BOND RATE ON TALIBOR.

text.p: Huvitusfond (Compensation Fund) will change the way it calculates interest payments for its new ninth series bond issue to make assessing the bond's value easier, Aripaev business newspaper said on Wednesday.
Huvitusfond managing director Arle Molder said that the group plans to link the interest rate calculation to the Talibor interbank loan rate, the newspaper quoted him as saying.
"In the new system, if we take the interest of the bond from the Talibor, then it becomes predictable and the price of the bonds can be forecasted," he told the newspaper.
